text:
In an electrical circuit, what is the purpose of a fuse?
A
to connect the metal case of an appliance to the earth
B
to cut off the electrical supply if the current is too large
C
to keep an electrical appliance dry in damp conditions
D
to maintain a steady voltage as the current varies

options.label: A
options.text: to connect the metal case of an appliance to the earth

options.label: B
options.text: to cut off the electrical supply if the current is too large

options.label: C
options.text: to keep an electrical appliance dry in damp conditions

options.label: D
options.text: to maintain a steady voltage as the current varies
